unlisted_practices: Federated reinforcement learning to keep patient data local and decentralize model training for privacy
Multiobjective reward shaping to balance time in range, hypoglycemia, and glycemic risk in closed-loop insulin dosing

screen.reason: Evaluates a novel federated reinforcement learning algorithm (PRIMO-FRL) on a standard simulator (UVA/Padova) for glycemic control; reports model performance and simulated clinical safety outcomes but does not evaluate a deployable organizational safeguard or operational practice.
